scope: All Browserify module entries in the four shipped bundles; source archives are matching examples, not a reconstructed historical lockfile.
matching: Complete upstream source file occurs within bundle module after CRLF normalization and removal of sourceMappingURL comments. Browserify-injected wrappers remain outside that file. Duplicate references are resolved to their source module. Empty stubs and explicit package metadata are separately classified.

262.note: Nix-normalized dependency versions and registry metadata; identity/version explicit in bundle.
